summary.text: Custodial lead with 9+ years in hospital, office and school buildings who trains new staff and keeps patient areas clean under infection prevention procedures.

bullets.text: Lead a crew of 6 custodians on the overnight shift across three patient floors.
Build the weekly schedule for the 6-person crew and arrange coverage for call-offs, usually 2 or 3 times a month.
Clean and disinfect patient rooms, nurses' stations and restrooms following infection prevention procedures.
Trained 12 new hires on chemical safety, PPE and isolation-room cleaning.
Cut cleaning supply spending by 15% by switching to concentrated products and tracking usage weekly.
Managed supply ordering and inventory for the overnight shift.
Complete daily cleaning checklists and report maintenance problems through the work order system.
Cleaned offices, conference rooms, break rooms and restrooms across a 4-building office park.
Operated auto-scrubbers and floor burnishers to strip and refinish floors.
Cleaned classrooms and hallways after school hours.
